item.title: CrowdStrike Said in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
item.description: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector. Zscaler, which had a market value of $32 billion at the end of regular trading Friday, rose about 16% after the close. The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential. Bloomberg News Deals Reporter Ryan Gould reports on the deal. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bayer’s $7.25 Billion Roundup Settlement Approved by Judge
item.description: A Missouri judge approved a Bayer AG proposal to contain its mounting legal costs by paying as much as $7.25 billion to resolve tens of thousands of US lawsuits by people who blame the company’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers.

item.title: AI Euphoria Gives Way to Fear And ‘Face-Ripping Volatility’
item.description: All year, investors have gorged themselves on whatever the AI trade served up. Hundreds of billions of dollars of stock sold to build out infrastructure. Near-daily bond offerings to pay for chips and data centers. History’s two largest IPOs.

item.title: Carrie Underwood on Her New Wellness Brand, HiNote
item.description: HiNote Founder Carrie Underwood and CEO Kerrigan Behrens discuss the wellness brand’s origins and plans to grow production of its flagship drink mix following a new investment. They speak with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close” (Source: Bloomberg)
